<!--

issue_context.title: Infinite loop after recording with camera
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I am getting an infinite loop in this function [#80370](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/6551eb168d1f7362500d9213793ecad559255565/homeassistant/components/stream/fmp4utils.py#L148) after recording with a Tapo Camera C200. I think the issue may/must be that if `len(box_header) == 8 && box_header[4:8] != b'moov' && box_header[0:4] == 0` the loop will never finish. I confirmed this by changing the code to:
```
def find_moov(mp4_io: BufferedIOBase) -> int:
    """Find location of moov atom in a BufferedIOBase mp4."""
    index = 0
    while 1:
        mp4_io.seek(index)
        box_header = mp4_io.read(8)
        if len(box_header) != 8:
            raise HomeAssistantError("moov atom not found")
        if box_header[4:8] == b"moov":
            return index
        tmp = int.from_bytes(box_header[0:4], byteorder="big")
        if tmp == 0: raise HomeAssistantError("moov atom not found")
        index += tmp
```

@gilcu3 Thanks for this, we can be defensive here and work around the case where the size is 0. <s>I was not aware of this, but it does appear that the length is allowed to be 0 for mp4 atoms (it means that the atom extends to the end of the file). </s> For curiousity, as we have not seen any other cases where this was happening - do you have any other details about when this occurs? E.g., Codec info, keyframe interval, clip length

Edit: It's probably not relevant whether it's valid or not valid as it seems like an unexpected result possibly from corrupt memory.

review_comments: On a general note, this looks like something that should be in a separate library, not in Home Assistant Core 🤷‍♂️
We've discussed moving this out of core, and I think we generally agreed it makes sense, but haven't made the plan in more detail or executed on it yet.
